overview.en: Pediatric strabismus, conjunctivitis, otitis media/externa and myringotomy, tonsillitis with tonsillectomy care, epistaxis and allergic rhinitis. Post-tonsillectomy bleeding recognition and ear/eye medication technique are frequent test points.
overview.zh: 小兒斜視、結膜炎、中耳炎/外耳炎與鼓膜切開術、扁桃腺炎與扁桃腺切除術照護、流鼻血與過敏性鼻炎。術後出血辨識與耳/眼藥使用技巧為常考重點。

points.en: Eyes misaligned from extraocular muscle imbalance, congenital defect or poor vision; normal in young infants but not after about 4 months.
points.zh: 眼外肌失衡、先天缺陷或視力不佳造成眼位不正；嬰兒早期屬正常，約 4 個月後不應再有。

points.en: Untreated causes amblyopia (reduced acuity) and permanent vision loss because the brain suppresses the misaligned eye.
points.zh: 未治療會造成弱視（視力下降）與永久視力喪失，因大腦抑制偏斜眼。

points.en: Assess with six cardinal gaze positions, corneal light reflex, cover-uncover test.
points.zh: 以六個基本注視方向、角膜光反射、遮蓋-移開測試評估。

points.en: Signs: crossed eyes, head tilting or closing one eye, impaired depth perception, headaches, diplopia.
points.zh: 徵象：眼睛交叉、歪頭或閉一眼、深度知覺受損、頭痛、複視。

points.en: Treatment: glasses, patching the good eye, surgery if needed, follow-up visits.
points.zh: 治療：配戴眼鏡、遮蓋好眼、必要時手術、定期追蹤。

points.en: Viral, bacterial or allergic; viral and bacterial forms are very contagious. Signs: itching, burning, redness, edema, discharge.
points.zh: 病毒、細菌或過敏性；病毒與細菌性傳染力強。徵象：癢、灼熱、紅、水腫、分泌物。

points.en: Viral resolves in 7-14 days (antivirals only for herpes simplex or varicella zoster); antibiotics do not treat viruses.
points.zh: 病毒性 7–14 天自癒（僅單純疱疹或水痘帶狀疱疹用抗病毒藥）；抗生素對病毒無效。

points.en: Bacterial: topical antibiotic drops/ointment shorten course and spread; allergic: remove allergen, antihistamine drops.
points.zh: 細菌性：外用抗生素眼藥水/藥膏縮短病程與傳播；過敏性：去除過敏原、抗組織胺眼藥水。

points.en: Do not touch dropper tip to eye or lashes; handwashing; no sharing towels; no eye rubbing; discard contact lenses and eye makeup.
points.zh: 滴管尖端勿碰眼睛或睫毛；勤洗手；不共用毛巾；不揉眼；丟棄隱形眼鏡與眼妝。

points.en: Chlamydial conjunctivitis in a child who is not sexually active requires evaluation for sexual abuse.
points.zh: 未有性行為孩童出現披衣菌結膜炎，須評估是否遭性侵。

points.en: Blocked eustachian tube; children's tubes are shorter, wider, straighter. Often follows RSV, influenza or group A strep infections.
points.zh: 耳咽管阻塞；兒童耳咽管較短、寬、直。常繼發於 RSV、流感或 A 群鏈球菌感染。

points.en: Prevention: upright feeding, immunizations, breastfeeding for at least 6 months, avoid smoke and allergens.
points.zh: 預防：直立餵食、按時接種、至少哺乳 6 個月、避免菸害與過敏原。

points.en: Signs: fever, ear pain, irritability, pulling the ear, head rolling, purulent drainage; red, opaque, bulging, immobile tympanic membrane.
points.zh: 徵象：發燒、耳痛、易怒、拉耳朵、搖頭、膿性耳漏；鼓膜紅、混濁、膨出、不動。

points.en: Care: fluids, limit chewing, lie with affected ear down, heat or cold as prescribed, acetaminophen/ibuprofen, complete antibiotics; watchful waiting up to 72 hours may be used in healthy older infants.
points.zh: 照護：補充水分、少咀嚼、患耳朝下側臥、依醫囑冷熱敷、乙醯胺酚/ibuprofen、完成抗生素；健康大嬰兒可觀察至 72 小時。

points.en: Screen for hearing loss; otitis externa (swimmer's ear): pain on pinna/tragus manipulation, topical antibiotics.
points.zh: 須篩檢聽力；外耳炎（游泳者耳）：拉動耳廓/耳屏疼痛、外用抗生素。

points.en: Ear drops: under 3 years pull earlobe down and back; over 3 years pull pinna up and back.
points.zh: 滴耳藥：3 歲以下耳垂向下向後拉；3 歲以上耳廓向上向後拉。

points.en: Incision in tympanic membrane drains fluid; tubes equalize pressure and ventilate.
points.zh: 鼓膜切開引流中耳積液；通氣管平衡壓力並通氣。

points.en: Keep ears dry; earplugs for bathing, shampooing, swimming; no diving or submerging.
points.zh: 保持耳朵乾燥；洗澡洗頭游泳戴耳塞；不可潛水或浸入水中。

points.en: No nose blowing for 7-10 days; analgesics for discomfort.
points.zh: 7–10 天內不可擤鼻；疼痛給止痛藥。

points.en: Tubes fall out in 6-12 months (small white spool-shaped); not an emergency but notify provider.
points.zh: 通氣管 6–12 個月自行脫落（白色小捲軸狀）；非緊急但須通知醫師。

points.en: Viral, bacterial (group A strep) or fungal; enlarged tonsils/adenoids cause snoring, mouth breathing, nasal speech, obstructive sleep apnea.
points.zh: 病毒、細菌（A 群鏈球菌）或黴菌；扁桃腺/腺樣體腫大造成打鼾、口呼吸、鼻音、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止。

points.en: Group A strep ('strep throat') tonsillitis can rarely progress to streptococcal toxic shock syndrome, a severe complication; infectious mononucleosis is another possible cause of tonsillitis/adenoiditis.
points.zh: A 群鏈球菌（鏈球菌性咽喉炎）扁桃腺炎罕見情況下可進展為鏈球菌性毒性休克症候群，屬嚴重併發症；傳染性單核球增多症也是扁桃腺炎/腺樣體炎的可能病因之一。

points.en: Signs: sore throat, bright red tonsils with exudate, dysphagia, fever, bad breath, cough.
points.zh: 徵象：喉嚨痛、扁桃腺鮮紅有滲出物、吞嚥困難、發燒、口臭、咳嗽。

points.en: Preop: check for active infection, bleeding/clotting studies (PT), loose teeth, prepare for sore throat.
points.zh: 術前：檢查有無感染、出凝血檢查（PT）、鬆動牙齒、告知術後喉痛。

points.en: Surgery depends on infections per year and obstructive disturbance.
points.zh: 手術依每年感染次數與呼吸阻塞程度決定。

points.en: Position prone or side-lying; suction equipment ready but do not suction unless obstruction.
points.zh: 採俯臥或側臥；備抽吸設備但除非阻塞勿抽吸。

points.en: Bleeding signs: frequent swallowing or throat clearing; bright red vomit; turn child to side and notify provider.
points.zh: 出血徵象：頻繁吞嚥或清喉嚨；嘔吐鮮紅血；側臥並通知醫師。

points.en: Avoid coughing, throat clearing, nose blowing; ice collar and analgesics; antiemetics.
points.zh: 避免咳嗽、清喉嚨、擤鼻；冰領與止痛；止吐藥。

points.en: Clear, cool, noncitrus, noncarbonated fluids; avoid red/purple/brown liquids and milk products initially; no straws or sharp objects.
points.zh: 給清澈、冰涼、非柑橘、非碳酸飲料；避免紅/紫/棕色液體與初期乳製品；不用吸管或尖銳物。

points.en: Mild fever, bad breath, ear pain for a few days; report bleeding, persistent earache or fever; normal activity in 1-2 weeks.
points.zh: 數日內可有輕微發燒、口臭、耳痛；出血、持續耳痛或發燒須通報；1–2 週恢復活動。

points.en: Epistaxis from trauma, foreign body, nose picking; recurrent/severe bleeding suggests underlying disease.
points.zh: 鼻出血來自外傷、異物、挖鼻；反覆或嚴重出血提示潛在疾病。

points.en: First aid: sit up, lean forward, continuous pressure with thumb and finger at least 10 minutes, ice to bridge, ED if uncontrolled.
points.zh: 急救：坐起前傾、拇指食指持續加壓至少 10 分鐘、鼻梁冰敷、無法止血送急診。

points.en: Allergic rhinitis: itchy watery eyes, clear drainage, dark circles, pale nasal mucosa, cobblestoning; test for allergies, eczema, asthma.
points.zh: 過敏性鼻炎：眼癢流淚、清水鼻涕、黑眼圈、鼻黏膜蒼白、鵝卵石樣咽部；評估過敏、濕疹、氣喘。

points.en: Treat with trigger avoidance, antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids.
points.zh: 治療：避開誘發物、抗組織胺、鼻用類固醇。

critical_points.en: Post-tonsillectomy bright red vomit or frequent swallowing = bleeding: turn to side, notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 扁桃腺術後嘔鮮紅血或頻繁吞嚥＝出血：側臥並通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Prone or side-lying after tonsillectomy; avoid suctioning unless obstructed.
critical_points.zh: 扁桃腺術後俯臥或側臥；除非阻塞勿抽吸。
扁桃腺手術前確認 PT/凝血檢查。

critical_points.en: Avoid red, purple, brown fluids, milk products, straws after tonsillectomy.
critical_points.zh: 術後避免紅紫棕色液體、乳製品、吸管。

critical_points.en: Chlamydial conjunctivitis in a child: investigate sexual abuse.
critical_points.zh: 孩童披衣菌結膜炎：調查是否性侵。

critical_points.en: Never share towels or washcloths with bacterial conjunctivitis.
critical_points.zh: 細菌性結膜炎不可共用毛巾。

critical_points.en: Complete the full antibiotic course for otitis media.
critical_points.zh: 中耳炎須吃完整個抗生素療程。

critical_points.en: Ear drops: under 3 years pull lobe down/back; over 3 years pull up/back.
critical_points.zh: 滴耳：3 歲以下向下向後；3 歲以上向上向後。

critical_points.en: Strabismus not corrected early leads to amblyopia; treat with patching the good eye.
critical_points.zh: 斜視未早期矯正致弱視；遮蓋好眼治療。

critical_points.en: Tympanostomy tubes: keep ears dry, no nose blowing 7-10 days.
critical_points.zh: 通氣管：耳朵保持乾燥、7–10 天不擤鼻。

critical_points.en: Epistaxis: sit up, lean forward, pinch 10 minutes; do not lie back.
critical_points.zh: 鼻出血：坐起前傾、捏鼻 10 分鐘；勿仰躺。

critical_points.en: Toddlers with strabismus tilt the head or close an eye.
critical_points.zh: 斜視幼兒會歪頭或閉一眼。

critical_points.en: Group A strep throat/tonsillitis is a potential trigger for streptococcal toxic shock syndrome; watch for rapid deterioration.
critical_points.zh: A 群鏈球菌咽喉炎/扁桃腺炎可能誘發鏈球菌性毒性休克症候群；需留意病況快速惡化。

mnemonics.en: Ear drops direction: Under 3 = Down; Over 3 = Up.
mnemonics.zh: 滴耳方向：3 歲以下往下；3 歲以上往上。
